name: Seal-Bot
description: Production Telegram character-collection bot with a secondary game bot, FastAPI backend, and React Telegram Mini App.

TOKEN.description: Main Telegram bot token from BotFather.

WEB_APP_URL.description: Public HTTPS origin of the Mini App, e.g. https://<app-name>.herokuapp.com.

REDIS_URL.description: Redis connection string for sessions, rate limits, leaderboards, and hot reads.

SUDO_USERS.description: Comma-separated startup moderator Telegram user IDs.

MAIN_GROUP_ID.description: Main community/group ID used by logs and giveaway notifications.

GALLERY_CHANNEL_ID.description: Channel where uploaded character media is posted or edited.

LOG_GROUP_ID.description: Review/log group for startup reports and update proposals.

SUPPORT_CHAT.description: Support chat username used in buttons and starter checks.

UPDATE_CHAT.description: Update channel username used in buttons and starter checks.

IMGBB_API_KEY.description: Optional image host key for upload fallback paths.

STRING_SESSION.description: Optional userbot session string for scraper access.

LOG_LEVEL.description: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

LOG_FORMAT.description: text or json. Use json for centralized logging.

LOG_FILE_ENABLED.description: Write rotating file logs in addition to stdout. Keep false in containers.
